note: Only addons that were reviewed and tested by a maintainer are listed here. See docs/ADDONS.md for how to get yours added.

addons.name: broadcast_alerts
addons.title: BC traffic bot
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: DriveBC, BC Ferries, BC Transit, TransLink, weather, earthquake and tsunami alerts. Keeps the map layers up to date; broadcasting them to the mesh is off until you switch it on (a switch per alert type).

addons.name: auto_reply
addons.title: Auto reply
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: Keyword rules: answer the words you choose on the channels you choose, with your own reply text, sent to the channels you pick. Comes with a 'test' rule.

addons.name: dolphins
addons.title: Dolphins
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: Fun actions in the right-click menu on a name (Fun): slap with a large trout, send a pod of dolphins, water balloon, anvil, penguins, a fresh battery, ... - your own list, editable in its settings; /dolphins, /slap and /fun. Only sends when you click or type it; one per 10 seconds. Replaces the Slap addon. Also a picture behind the channel list - a pod of dolphins drawn by mcIRC, or your own - with each channel name in a box (on by default; needs Pillow - mcIRC offers to install it).
addons.tested: 2026-10-04 with app 1.5.2 (no radio; sending is covered by tests with a fake radio). Channel-list picture: 2026-10-04 with app 2.0.2 on Windows, checked on screen. Fun actions: 2026-10-04 with app 2.0.3 (no radio; sending covered by tests)

addons.name: modern_look
addons.title: Modern look
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: Flat, modern window chrome - toolbar, buttons, tabs, status bar, scrollbars and dialogs - in the colours of your skin or colour theme. Switch it off to get the classic look back. Never transmits anything.
addons.tested: 2026-10-04 with app 1.5.2 on Windows (demo mode and screenshots); Linux only in CI

addons.name: weather_bot
addons.title: Weather bot
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: Answers weather commands in the channels you choose (default #weather): wx <place> (city, postal code, ZIP, node name or lat,lon), gwx, aqi, sun, moon, solar, sf, hfcond, satpass, airplanes, rain, aurora, channels, status, contact. Free data, no API keys. Off until you switch it on; rate-limited. satpass needs 'pip install sgp4'.
addons.tested: 2026-10-04 with app 1.5.2: every data source checked live; answering checked with canned data and a stand-in radio (not over the air yet)

addons.name: fun_bot
addons.title: Fun bot
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: dice, roll, magic8, joke, dadjoke, hacker, catfact and wc (World Cup scores and tables), each switched on for the channels you choose. Off until you switch it on; rate-limited.
addons.tested: 2026-10-04 with app 1.5.2: every data source checked live; answering checked with canned data and a stand-in radio (not over the air yet)

addons.name: bot_help
addons.title: Bot help
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: Answers 'bothelp' with the bot commands that work in that channel (Weather bot, Fun bot, Auto reply, ...), and can announce 'Type bothelp for a list of commands.' once a day at a set time. Choose which bots it lists. Off until you switch it on; rate-limited.
addons.tested: 2026-10-04 with app 1.5.2 with a stand-in radio (not over the air yet)

addons.name: channel_list
addons.title: Channel list
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: Answers 'channel list' with the channels you keep in its list (add / remove / rename / reorder them in Options, and people can add one with 'channel list add #name' - checked names, at most 30, you see who added what; starts with 13 BC channels). Off until you switch it on; one answer per person per minute.
addons.tested: 2026-10-04 with app 1.5.3 with a stand-in radio (not over the air yet)

addons.name: node_tools
addons.title: MeshCore tools
addons.author: bclml
addons.description: Node clock (check and set), channel manager (add / rename / re-key / remove, duplicates shown), backup & restore (settings, channels, contacts, optional identity), firmware check and update for ESP32 boards, a Wi-Fi firmware builder (your Wi-Fi in MeshCore's companion firmware, flashed and added as a node), a version list with the newest preselected, a Node: choice to work on any connected node, path tools (show / discover / reset / trace, repeater status and neighbours), live packet monitor, radio health graphs and a coverage map. Firmware updates need 'pip install esptool'.
addons.tested: 2026-10-04 with app 1.5.4 on a Heltec V3 (fw 1.16.0): every read checked on the real node; writing (clock set, channel edits, restore, firmware update) checked with a stand-in radio only. Wi-Fi firmware: built and flashed to a real Heltec V4 with app 2.0.1 (v1.17.1, found on the network, name and radio written over Wi-Fi)

addons.name: map_uploader
addons.title: Map uploader
addons.author: bclml (Python port of recrof/map.meshcore.io-uploader, MIT)
addons.description: Puts the repeaters, room servers and sensors your node hears on the official MeshCore map (map.meshcore.io). Only adverts really signed by their node; each upload is signed by your node itself - its private key never leaves the radio. People's companions are never uploaded. Off until you switch it on.
addons.tested: 2026-10-08 with app 2.0.4: decoding, signature checks, replay rules and the request covered by tests with real Ed25519-signed adverts; signing on a real node and a real upload not yet tried

addons.name: packet_upload
addons.title: Packet upload
addons.author: bclml (after agessaman/meshcore-packet-capture, MIT)
addons.description: Sends the packets your node hears to community packet analyzers (MeshCore.ca, CascadiaMesh, LetsMesh and 14 more) over MQTT, on mcIRC's own connection, so they can map coverage and routes. Logs in with a token your node signs - no password, the private key never leaves the radio. Off until you switch it on and give your area code. Needs 'pip install paho-mqtt'.
addons.tested: 2026-10-08 with app 2.0.5: messages, packet hashes and the log-in token checked against the upstream uploader's own code; MQTT connection, token renewal and offline status covered by tests with a fake broker; not yet tried against a real analyzer

addons.name: mesh_bot
addons.title: Mesh bot
addons.author: bclml (commands after agessaman/meshcore-bot, MIT)
addons.description: ping, hello, path (the repeaters your message came through), prefix (who uses a key prefix), multitest (the paths your message took), stats (the mesh in 24 h), sports and version - the meshcore-bot commands mcIRC's other bots don't have - plus its greeter for newcomers (off by default). Each switched on for the channels you choose; answers in the channel or privately. Off until you switch it on.
addons.tested: 2026-10-08 with app 2.0.6: every command covered by tests with fake node memory, heard packets and sports data; not yet tried on the mesh
